name: coveragepy_ea69_public_delivery_v1
purpose: 交付固定公开题面，复用公开读者的HTML生成及公开测试；单独核公开open替身签名，不做求解修改。

steps.command: id; echo VIRTUAL_ENV=$VIRTUAL_ENV; echo RH2_BASHENV_WRITE=$( ( : >> /rh2/bash_env ) 2>/dev/null && echo WRITABLE || echo DENIED ); python -c 'import sys; print("RH2_SYS_EXECUTABLE="+sys.executable)'; python -c 'import coverage, coverage.html; print("coverage", coverage.__version__, coverage.__file__)'; (cd / && python -c 'import coverage; print("cwd=/ coverage", coverage.__file__)'); command -v git coverage || true; python -m pip --version 2>&1 | head -1; python -m pytest --version 2>&1 | head -1; git status --porcelain=v1; echo PORCELAIN_RC=$?

python - <<'EOF'
import os, sys, tempfile
sys.path.insert(0, "/testbed")
import coverage
print("coverage from:", coverage.__file__)
work = tempfile.mkdtemp()
os.chdir(work)
with open("demo.py", "w") as f:
    f.write("def f(x):\n    if x:\n        return 1\n    return 2\n\nf(1)\n")
sys.path.insert(0, work)
cov = coverage.Coverage()
cov.start()
import demo
cov.stop()
cov.html_report(directory="htmlcov")
print(sorted(os.listdir("htmlcov")))
gi = os.path.join("htmlcov", ".gitignore")
print(".gitignore exists:", os.path.exists(gi))
if os.path.exists(gi):
    with open(gi) as f:
        print(repr(f.read()))
EOF

D=$(mktemp -d) && printf 'def f(x):
    return x + 1

f(1)
' > "$D/demo.py" && ( cd "$D" && export PYTHONPATH=/testbed && python -m coverage run demo.py && python -m coverage html -d htmlcov && ls -A htmlcov && echo '--- htmlcov/.gitignore:' && { cat htmlcov/.gitignore || true; } && if command -v git >/dev/null 2>&1; then git init -q . && echo '--- git status (htmlcov only):' && git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all -- htmlcov; else echo '(git not found; skipped)'; fi )

cd /testbed && python - <<'PYCODE'
import os, tempfile
from tests.test_html import FileWriteTracker
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as work:
    with FileWriteTracker(set()).open(os.path.join(work, 'example.txt'), 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        f.write('example\n')
PYCODE

known_public_limit: 原公开 FileWriteTracker.open 只接 filename/mode；私有R-b修改不改变公开测试。单独保留实际结果，不把该公开替身限制当作encoding方案的语义错误。
